title: Finite reductions of the ordinary integral projection
statement: In the finite-field setting [sk-def-sf-setting], for any separated finite-type morphism f:X→Y between finite-type schemes and any supplied compactification c, any supplied representative-normalized tensor models on X, c.Z and Y, and integral constructible K,L [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], each finite scalar reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] of the ordinary proper-counit/open-extension projection [def-exchange-projection] over the completed coefficient sheaf [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] is invertible. This asserts invertibility after reduction only.

source.place: Finite reduction of the canonical completed-coefficient projection and conservativity of derived-complete objects.

proof.text: For each integral input, finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin gives a bounded constructible etale origin of its intrinsic finite reduction. The derived constant-scalar equivalence and comparison composition carry this to bounded constructibility of the inverse realization. The integral predicate supplies the common support interval directly.

The coefficient prime is invertible in the base field, hence in every residue field of Y. Integral residue Tor gives a Tor interval for the reduction of L. Transport its tensor-vanishing tests through the constant-scalar realization counit and apply intrinsic Tor amplitude transport to get the fixed-scalar Tor interval.

Apply the published pro-etale finite-coefficient compactification projection formula to the two inverse realizations, using bounded constructibility and the Tor interval from the preceding steps. Realization preserves invertibility. The reduction-arrow comparison identifies its arrow with the reduction of the ordinary integral projection. Use the arrow square and its invertible endpoints to express the latter as a conjugate, which is invertible.

theorem integralOrdinaryProjection_finiteReductions
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f)
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X))
    (aZ : ProEtaleTensorModel c.Z ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring c.Z))
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y))
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).map
      (((PurCompactSupport.projectionMap (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) c aX aZ aY
        (PurCompactSupport.completedPull_comp l E c.i c.g)).app K.obj).app L.obj))
